facts.text: Jolene asked Deborah for advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga.

evidence.quote: I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?

facts.text: Deborah advised Jolene to practice mindful breathing for yoga, suggesting setting aside a few minutes each day to sit with closed eyes, take deep breaths, and focus on the sensation of air entering and leaving the body.

evidence.quote: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body.
